newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BELGIUM V NETHERLANDS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR BELGIUM V NETHERLANDS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup European group seven qualifier between Belgium and the Netherlands on Saturday:

Belgium - 1-Filip De Wilde, 2-Eric Deflandre, 3-Eric Van Meir, 4-Pascal Renier, 6-Philippe Albert, 5-Philippe Leonard, 8-Marc Wilmots, 7-Lorenzo Staelens, 9-Marc Degryse, 10-Luc Nilis, 11-Luis Oliveira

Netherlands - 1-Edwin van der Sar, 2-Michael Reiziger, 4-Frank de Boer, 3-Jaap Stam, 5-Arthur Numan, 7-Aron Winter, 6-Wim Jonk, 10-Clarence Seedorf, 11-Phillip Cocu, 8-Ronald de Boer, 9-Dennis Bergkamp
